# Copilot adapter

Use only the canonical repository control plane:

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `ARCHITECTURE.md`
3. `TASKS.md`
4. The assigned `agent-tasks/NNN-*.md`

Do not create a separate Copilot/VS Code planning system, task board, handoff, completion definition, or agent hierarchy. Preserve the production-safety and owner-approval gates in `AGENTS.md`.
